title: Addus HomeCare to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conferences in May
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about Addus HomeCare's business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
body_markdown:
[PDF Version](https://addus.gcs-web.com/node/14561/pdf)


FRISCO, Texas--(BUSINESS WIRE)--May 5, 2026-- Addus HomeCare Corporation (Nasdaq: ADUS), a provider of home care services, today announced its participation at the following investor conferences in May:


- **BofA Securities 2026 Health Care Conference** in Las Vegas, Nevada, on Tuesday, May 12, 2026. Dirk Allison, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, Heather Dixon, President and Chief Operating Officer and Brian Poff, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, will present at 4:40 p.m. Pacific Time / 6:40 p.m. Central Time on Tuesday, May 12, 2026.
- **RBC Capital Markets 2026 Global Healthcare Conference** in New York on Tuesday, May 19, 2026. Dirk Allison, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer and Brian Poff, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer will present at 8:00 a.m. Eastern Time / 7:00 a.m. Central Time on Tuesday, May 19, 2026.


In connection with the virtual conferences, there will be a live broadcast and replay of the Company’s presentation available under the Investor Relations section of the Company’s website,[www.addus.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Faddus.com%2F&esheet=54529111&newsitemid=20260505341148&lan=en-US&anchor=www.addus.com&index=1&md5=8762b6d7f9b78ee2bb5ac3596ddca37e) . An online replay will also be available on the Company’s website for one month, beginning approximately one hour following the conclusion of the live broadcast.


**About Addus HomeCare**


Addus HomeCare is a provider of home care services that primarily include personal care services that assist with activities of daily living, as well as hospice and home health services. Addus HomeCare’s consumers are primarily persons who, without these services, are at risk of hospitalization or institutionalization, such as the elderly, chronically ill and disabled. Addus HomeCare’s payor clients include federal, state, and local governmental agencies, managed care organizations, commercial insurers, and private individuals. Addus HomeCare currently provides home care services to approximately 62,750 patients and consumers through 263 locations across 24 states. For more information, please visit[www.addus.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.addus.com&esheet=54529111&newsitemid=20260505341148&lan=en-US&anchor=www.addus.com&index=2&md5=c122282ac35be66a657cb6e8ac660f64) .
